text:
Nina: hey all, nina here  starting as AE next week. Couple quick setup asks: HubSpot seat, Gong access, Dialpad softphone for demos, demo laptop image, and where the canonical AE playbook + 1-pager collateral lives. also: who to DM for slide customizations and shadowing slots?
Onboarding Bot: welcome @Nina! :tada: Provision ticket created: https://redwood.in/onboard/Nina. Complete the form to kick off seats & device requests. You'll be auto-added to #sales-onboarding once approved.
Marta (sales-ops): hi @Nina  I'll own HubSpot & Gong. Please include your preferred email alias and timezone on the form. For Dialpad: softphone or forwarded number? Also give the caller ID string you want for demos.
Nina: softphone please. Caller ID: "Redwood - Nina". Form submitted (just now).
Marta (sales-ops): got the form. HubSpot seat queued, Gong invite pending (check spam if you don't see). Dialpad softphone request logged; typical provisioning <24h.
Jared (IT): for the demo laptop image: mac-m1 or ubuntu-22? We image and push MDM. After image, run the bootstrap: 
```
bash -c "curl -fsSL https://dl.redwood/setup-onboard.sh | sudo bash"
```
I'll kick off a mac-m1 build unless you request otherwise. ETA ~2-3 hours.
Nina: mac-m1 please, thanks.
Olivia (AE-buddy): hey @Nina! i've got a "week1" folder: playbook, call scripts, objection cheat sheet, 4 recorded demos, and a shadow calendar. Happy to have you shadow Wed 11am or Thu 3pm. I'll DM access.
Nina: wed 11 works for me  excited to shadow.
Cass (marketing): @Nina i'll drop the up-to-date 1-pager, product one-pager, and the case studies slide pack into the shared drive. If you need a tailored slide for a demo, DM me the logo + one-liner and i'll assemble it.
Nina: quick question on recorded demos: what's our consent language and where are the Loom templates?
Marta (sales-ops): consent + recording policy are covered in the "Demo checklist" training module (link in your onboarding email). Loom accounts come from Tools; ping @tools if you don't get an invite.
Jared (IT): build started, you'll get an email with the device image and a temporary admin account when it's finished. If you need the Dialpad desktop app earlier, download from https://dialpad.app and sign in once your account exists.
Nina: amazing, appreciate it everyone. thanks for the quick responses  looking forward to starting!
